description: Standard metadata in `pyproject.toml`: name, version, `requires-python`, dependencies and extras.
Names the build backend and its requirements; installing an sdist runs that backend.
Named developer dependency lists (test, lint) that are never published in the package metadata.
Exact versions and hashes for every dependency: `uv.lock`, a hashed `requirements.txt`, or the standard `pylock.toml` (PEP 751).
`--require-hashes` makes pip fail on any unpinned or unhashed requirement; it verifies artifacts, not their behavior.
A public package with an internal package's name wins when indexes are merged, as `--extra-index-url` does.
PyPI accepts uploads from a CI identity via OpenID Connect and short-lived tokens, instead of long-lived API tokens.
